chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: that he was asked about a man who insulted the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, so he said:
The nearest one, then the next nearest, kills him before he is brought before the Imam.

key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What does Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām say about the ruling on someone who insults the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling concerning one who insults the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It indicates that such a case was treated with utmost seriousness in Islamic law and connected to the authority of the Imam.
